name: app-black-thank-you-for-scrolling-closing-slide
title: Thank You for Scrolling Closing Slide
whatItIs: A black closing slide with a huge white 'Thank you for scrolling' headline, a lime-tinted invitation line, an orange logo pill, a lime thumbs-up bubble and a tilted phone showing a cream climate-control screen.
whatItMeans: Big friendly type ends a case study with warmth, and glowing pills add playful sign-off energy.
techniques: Oversized lightweight headline as the main graphic
Glowing pill stickers (logo, thumbs-up) overlapping the text
Phone cropped off the right edge at an angle
Deep black with subtle radial lift
bestFor: Contact and hiring calls to action

vocabulary.definition: The final slide thanking viewers and inviting contact.
A rounded label with a soft coloured glow.
A device cut off by the frame edge.
